name: kalpana-designer
description: Create ad creatives, social media posts, banners and carousels from a brief, as editable designs in Kalpana you can reuse for every campaign.

interface.longDescription: Kalpana Designer makes ad creatives, social media posts, banners, carousels and slides from a short brief. Say what the design is for, where it will run and what your brand looks like, and it builds an editable design in your Kalpana workspace with your fonts, logos and product photos. It checks the layout and previews the result before handing it over. Every design is ready to reuse: fill it with new text and images for each product or campaign with Kalpana Batch.
defaultPrompt: Design a 1080x1080 post for my brand's new product with a photo, headline and call to action.
Make a story-size copy of my latest template.
Turn this template into a five-page carousel.

positive.description: Design a post from a brief. Passes when a new 1080x1080 page exists with layers named for their content and a preview is shown. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Design a 1080x1080 Diwali sale post for Review Store with a product photo from the Review Products collection, a headline, the price ₹2,499 and a Shop now button.
positive.tools_triggered: design_guide, list_fonts, find_images, create_design, create_layers, check_layout, render_design
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new 1080x1080 page in the workspace with layers named for what they hold (Headline, Price, Product photo, CTA), checks the layout, fixes any issue it reports, and shows a preview of the finished post.

positive.description: Preview an existing template without changing it. Passes when a preview image is shown and the template is unchanged. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Show me a preview of my Diwali Sale Banner template.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the template, lists its page, and shows a preview image of it. Nothing changes.

positive.description: Make another size of an existing design. Passes when the template gains a 1080x1920 page and its preview is shown. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Make a 1080x1920 story version of the Diwali Sale Banner and fix anything that doesn't fit.
positive.tools_triggered: search_templates, pages, duplicate, render_design, check_layout, update_layers
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 1080x1920 copy of the page to the same template, renders it, adjusts what the new size needs, and shows the result.

positive.description: Add motion and check it as frames. Passes when the two layers have motion and a contact sheet is shown. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: On the Diwali Sale Banner, fade in the headline and pop in the price, then show me the frames.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the two motions to the named layers and shows a contact sheet of frames so the timing can be checked.

positive.description: Name a template and describe its inputs. Passes when the template is saved under the new name with a description per input. Setup: sign in with the reviewer account and choose the OpenAI Review workspace, which holds the Diwali Sale Banner and Product Story templates, the Review Products image collection and a three-row draft batch.
positive.prompt: Name the Diwali Sale Banner template "Diwali Sale Post", describe it, and give each input a length limit.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the template with the new name, a one or two sentence description, and a description per input with its length limit (for example, Headline up to 2 lines). Returns the template's link.

negative.description: Filling a template with rows of data is Kalpana Batch's job, not the designer's. Expected: no Kalpana Designer tool is called to render rows.
negative.prompt: Render this banner for all 200 products in my spreadsheet.

negative.description: Editing a photo (removing a background, retouching) is not a designer tool. Expected: no Kalpana Designer tool is called and the photo is not said to have been edited.
negative.prompt: Remove the background from this photo of my product.

negative.description: The designer checks motion as frames and exports no video or audio. Expected: no Kalpana Designer tool is called to make a video and none is said to have been made.
negative.prompt: Make me a 2-minute explainer video with a voiceover about my store.

publication.release_notes: First release of Kalpana Designer for ChatGPT. Design editable marketing templates from a brief, with layout checks, previews, new sizes and motion, ready to fill with data in Kalpana Batch.
